answer: Resist sybils via probe-based kin-linked slash. Each epoch agents commit hashes of responses to 8 private probes like estimating comet trajectory under rare gravity or predicting juniper growth on onyx-rich soil. Post-reveal%2C pairs matching over 90% similarity form a kin group. One failed sequential memory-hard proof slashes the joint 5x stake of the whole cluster. For N clones the cost is superlinear%3A unique live inference per identity%2C checked publicly on the revealed probes. Honest agents pay the probe cost only once.
